question: The concept of fiscal policy is based fundamentally on the ideas of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__John Maynard Keynes.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **British economist John Maynard Keynes proposed the theory of Fiscal policy.**
 
• He gave a different outlook on macroeconomics and the economic policies of the government.
 
• He is well known for the theory called **'Keynesian Economics'**.
 
• He died on **April 21, 1946.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Milton Friedman:**

 
 
• ​He gave emphasis on monetary policy and his theory of money came to be known as **monetarism.**
 
 
 
• **Elinor Ostrom:**
 
 
• She was the first woman who was earlier awarded Nobel Prize for Economics.
 
• Elinor Ostrom and Oliver Williamson won the Nobel Prize for economics for work on how community institutions can prevent conflict in the year 2009.
